tasks.title: Characterize root union and Fresh request loss
tasks.goal: Capture actual multi-consumer and fast-path behavior before changing resolution.
steps: Build minimal fixtures with two workspace roots requesting one package under different constraints.
Record root deduplication and bare-install Fresh behavior when only requested features change.
Add regression characterizations and distinguish confirmed defects from hypotheses; do not silently rewrite lock semantics yet.
positive_cases: Explicit roots preserve unrelated held roots and existing dependency requirements.
negative_cases: A member constraint or newly requested feature cannot disappear behind first-wins/Fresh.
acceptance: Fixtures name every incoming consumer constraint and observed fast-path decision.
Confirmed gaps have failing/characterizing tests before solver edits.
tasks.safe_stop: Retain characterized behavior until the normalized request implementation follows.

tasks.title: Characterize feature syntax and solver capabilities
tasks.goal: Map supported activation semantics and conditional solver failure cases.
steps: Exercise qualified dependency/feature parsing, weak forwarding, exclusive/all-features and requires_any behavior.
Inventory actual supported naive/SAT/resolvo entry routes from their existing dispatch; report capability gaps explicitly.
Characterize wrong-version/name-present and negated conditional combinations before introducing new activation.
positive_cases: Legacy exclusive remains at-most-one and requires_any remains technical OR.
negative_cases: All-features is not definition validity for constrained groups.
Qualified names and weak forwarding cannot be split or activated incorrectly.
acceptance: Capability matrix reports implemented semantics and explicit unsupported combinations.
Conditional repros do not rely on a magic iteration count as proof.
tasks.safe_stop: A capability gap remains named rather than silently falling back.
